steps.do: Before you start: start CALIBER with CALIBER_FEATURE_INTEGRATIONS=true, the lab's upstream (assets/server/ticket_api.py) running and its host on CALIBER_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS, and OPENAPI_TICKET_TOKEN set in both. Click + New Integration, name it Ticketing, Create.
steps.see: The new integration's detail view opens, status draft.

steps.do: Click URL, paste the upstream's own /openapi.yaml address, click Check (reachable and allowed), then submit the import.
Select both GET /tickets and GET /tickets/{ticket_id}, check bind as one tool pack, and click Generate tool draft(s).
steps.see: Generated 1 tool draft: a pack binding both read operations.

steps.do: The row from createTicket to getTicket shows Auto-wired (an explicit OpenAPI link) with no action available. Filter to Awaiting Review and click Confirm on the same-tag advisory row.
steps.see: The auto-wired row carries no Confirm/Reject action; the advisory row's status becomes confirmed.

steps.do: Open the pack draft, set Auth kind to Bearer token and the secret reference to env://OPENAPI_TICKET_TOKEN, Save, then Publish.
steps.see: Tool published successfully, naming the tool id and openapi_http; Open in Tool Registry links to it.

steps.do: Select POST /tickets alone and Generate tool draft(s) (no pack this time). Open the new draft, set the same bearer auth, and click Publish without checking anything else.
steps.see: The draft's side-effect level is write and it already requires approval -- a write defaults to it.

steps.do: Try Preview on the write draft before touching allow in preview.
steps.see: Refused: set 'allow_in_preview' before running a live upstream call. Toggle allow in preview on, Preview again, confirm it ran against the upstream, then toggle it back off.

steps.do: With allow in preview off again, click Publish.
steps.see: Tool published successfully; the published tool still carries requires approval.

steps.do: Fill __TOOL_NAME__ in a copy of file-ticket.workflow.yaml with the published write tool's name. Import, Run with a ticket title as input. Approve yourself (refused), approve as the reviewer account in a second session, then Resume.
steps.see: Awaiting approval at call_tool; the account that triggered this run cannot approve it; a second person must decide; after the reviewer approves and you Resume, completed.

steps.do: Bump the upstream's served spec to v2 (POST /admin/bump-spec on the upstream itself), then click Reimport & diff.
steps.see: Re-imported OAIV-2: +0 -0 changed 2 (1 breaking) -- the deprecation is caught; the new required priority field on createTicket is not.
